name: agent-memory
title: Agent Memory Management MCP Server (AiRaccon)
scope: MCP server exposing sqlite-memory as a project-scoped agent memory backend
Mandatory project_id on every tool; one SQLite DB file per project

Workspace sandbox: writes naming a workspace_id land in an isolated workspace context (isolated by design, no flag), reads span project+workspace, consolidation promotes selected hashes to committed project memory
Hybrid semantic search (vector + FTS5) via memory_search with context/limit/min_score scoping
Memory write (text), file and directory ingestion, per-hash and per-context deletion
Per-project embedding configuration, local GGUF default, vectors.space remote optional
Deferred embeddings when no model is configured, embed_pending worker
First-class IMemoryExtension pipeline with retrieval-frequency rating and time/rating-based degradation (dry-run + real sweep)
Opt-in cloud sync via sqlite-sync + SQLite Cloud, committed project contexts only, workspace scratch never synced
MCP prompts (memory-usage-guide, workspace-consolidation-guide) teaching the agent protocol
ai-badger integration: agent-memory skill, mcp-index catalog entry, scaffolding wiring (framework repo)
outOfScope: REST/HTTP management API separate from MCP
Per-agent authentication or authorization beyond provenance agent_id
Single shared cloud memory bank with RLS (deferred, see deferred)

nonFunctional.concurrency: Multiple agent processes per project DB; WAL + busy_timeout; content-hash dedup makes concurrent identical writes safe; sync serialized per project
nonFunctional.secrets: Keys only from AIRACCON_* env vars or runtime config; never in tracked files; connection-scoped to memory_set_apikey/cloudsync_network_set_apikey
nonFunctional.logging: Nested static partial Log with [LoggerMessage] methods; stderr-only for stdio transport
nonFunctional.layering: Domain pure in AiRaccon.Core; SQLite/extension loading in AiRaccon.Infrastructure; MCP tools thin 1:1
nonFunctional.versioning: sqlite-memory 1.3.5, sqlite-vector 1.0.0, sqlite-sync 1.1.2 pinned; SHA-256 verified provisioning

constraints: MCP stays thin: tools map 1:1 to IMemoryStore/service calls, no SQL in Tools/
Do not alter dbmem_content schema (CRDT sync schema hash must match across replicas); AiRaccon metadata lives in local-only raccon_meta.db
Missing project_id is an invalid-params tool error, never auto-guessed
Extension binaries provisioned per-RID on first run; offline start fails with a clear expected-path message
TDD mandatory: failing behavior-focused xunit test before each production change
TreatWarningsAsErrors is on; new code must build warning-free
Central package versions in Directory.Packages.props only
